title.rendered: Be Transformed by the Renewing of Your Mind: The Gospel For Today

content.rendered:
Do not be conformed to this world. Be transformed by the renewing of your mind. The world has a shape it wants you to fit. God has a renewal He wants to work. The mind is the battleground where both meet.

The Gospel For Today | Tuesday, June 16, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is, his good, pleasing and perfect will.”
Romans 12:2 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul places two verbs against each other in this verse. Conform and transform. Both are passive in Greek. Both happen to you. The question is not whether something is being done to your mind. The question is which power gets to do it. The pattern of this world will shape you if you let it. The renewing power of the Spirit will shape you if you let it. There is no neutral.

The pattern of this world is patient. It works through endless small inputs. Social media feeds. Comparison with neighbours. Advertising designed by professionals who have studied the human mind for decades. Streaming algorithms that have learned what keeps you scrolling. Conversations at work that absorb you into the assumptions of people who do not know God. Movies that gently teach you what to want. None of it has to be spectacularly evil. It just has to be constant. A drop of water on stone, repeated, eventually shapes the stone.

The renewing of the mind is the counter-current the Spirit makes available. It happens through deliberate exposure to the Word of God. Through worship. Through prayer. Through fellowship with believers whose minds have also been renewed. Through obedience that proves what God has said is true. None of this is dramatic. All of it is cumulative. Drops of living water, repeated, reshaping the inner architecture of a soul.

The result Paul promises is striking. You will be able to test and approve what God’s will is. The renewed mind is not just a mind that thinks holy thoughts. It is a mind that can read situations rightly. It sees through the lies that the unrenewed mind cannot detect. It recognises the will of God in moments that confuse other people. It chooses well, again and again, because the inner compass has been recalibrated by the Spirit.

So examine what is shaping your mind today. The inputs you are absorbing are not neutral. They are forming you, hour by hour, toward conformity or toward transformation. Choose the renewing.

Prayer

Father, do not let me be conformed to the pattern of this world today. Renew my mind by Your Spirit. Recalibrate my inner compass. Let me see what You see, want what You want, and choose what pleases You. Make me able to test and approve Your good, pleasing and perfect will in every decision I face. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am not conformed to the pattern of this world. I am being transformed by the renewing of my mind. The Spirit of God is at work in my inner being today. My thinking is being recalibrated. My decisions are being shaped by the will of God.
